title: Categorical patterns and their fibered objects (fully scaled quasicategory case)
statement:
Use quasicategories, mapping spaces, coherent diagrams, limits, nerves and universes from [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], inner fibrations and cocartesian edges from [def-coef-infinity-fibrations], marked simplicial sets from [lem-coef-marked-point-cartesian-model], and the classification of cocartesian fibrations from [lem-coef-cocartesian-straightening]. A categorical pattern in this statement consists of a small quasicategory $C$, a set $S$ of its edges containing all degenerate edges, and a small family $\{p_\alpha:K_\alpha^{\triangleleft}\to C\}$, where each $K_\alpha$ is a small quasicategory and every edge of each cone maps into $S$. Here $K^{\triangleleft}=\Delta^0\star K$ is the simplicial left cone, with new initial vertex $*$; its simplices are those of $K$ and the simplices obtained by adjoining that initial vertex. All $2$-simplices of $C$ are included in the scaling; no partial scaling is being used. Write $\bar C=(C,S)$ and $\mathsf M_{\mathfrak P}=\mathrm{sSet}^+_{/\bar C}$, whose maps lie over $C$ and preserve marked edges.

For $\mathfrak P=(C,S,\{p_\alpha\})$, a marked object $(X,T)\to\bar C$ is $\mathfrak P$-fibered when: (i) $q:X\to C$ is an inner fibration; (ii) for every edge $a:c\to d$ in $S$ and every $x\in X_c$, there is a $q$-cocartesian edge $x\to y$ lying over $a$, and $T$ consists exactly of the $q$-cocartesian edges lying over $S$; (iii) for every $\alpha$, the pullback $X_\alpha\to K_\alpha^{\triangleleft}$ is a cocartesian fibration whose classifying functor to $\mathrm{Cat}_\infty$ is a limit diagram; and (iv) for every cocartesian section $s:K_\alpha^{\triangleleft}\to X_\alpha$, its composite $\bar s:K_\alpha^{\triangleleft}\to X$ is a $q$-limit diagram. Explicitly, the latter means that for every $x\in X$ the natural mapping-space square is a homotopy pullback:
$$\begin{matrix}\operatorname{Map}_X(x,\bar s(*))&\longrightarrow&\displaystyle\lim_{k\in K_\alpha}\operatorname{Map}_X(x,\bar s(k))\\ \downarrow&&\downarrow\\ \operatorname{Map}_C(qx,p_\alpha(*))&\longrightarrow&\displaystyle\lim_{k\in K_\alpha}\operatorname{Map}_C(qx,p_\alpha(k)).\end{matrix}$$
Empty $K_\alpha$ are allowed; an empty limit is the terminal object.
